instruction: Search the NFL website for the score record of the 2018 Super Bowl.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking to find 2018 Super Bowl scores instead of 2019. Uses the same NFL website navigation pattern with URL verification. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the expected 2018 Super Bowl scores page. Uses existing getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' and metric 'is_expected_active_tab' - no custom functions needed.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - only changes the year from 2019 to 2018, maintaining same complexity and navigation pattern
